d.ko: A unique hybrid between turn-based tactical games and traditional, character-centric RPGs. Knight's Tale is a modern retelling of a classic Arthurian mythology story filtered through the dark fantasy tropes, a twist on the traditional tales of chivalry.
d.en: A unique hybrid between turn-based tactical games and traditional, character-centric RPGs. Knight's Tale is a modern retelling of a classic Arthurian mythology story filtered through the dark fantasy tropes, a twist on the traditional tales of chivalry.
d.zh: 《Knight's Tale》是回合制策略游戏与以角色为中心的传统RPG的独特结合体，运用现代手法和黑暗奇幻比喻重新讲述经典的亚瑟王神话故事，创造性地诠释传统的骑士精神。
